module: Sends a support report to the BeamNG server from the UI. send triggers Engine.SupportReport.send; the engine calls back onSupportReportSent with the support identifier (or an error). The identifier is kept for 15 minutes in settings/lastSupportReport.json, then forgotten. The state is published to the UI through the guihook 'SupportReportState'.
notes: The state sent to the UI: {sending, supportId, expires, error, outdated}. expires is the expiration time (os.time), 0 if there is no identifier.
Server errors containing HTML (e.g. a proxy's 502 page) are reduced to their title or plain text.

requestState.desc: Forgets the expired report (deletes the file), then sends the current state to the UI (guihook SupportReportState).

send.desc: Starts sending the report (Engine.SupportReport.send) if none is already in progress, then publishes the state.

onSupportReportSent.desc: Engine callback when sending finishes. If supportId is not empty, stores it (JSON file); otherwise stores the error and the outdated flag. Republishes the state.

outdated.desc: True if the game is too old to send a report (inferred from code).

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Load hook: re-reads the last saved report and forgets it if expired.
